mobileAllowComputerControl: Allow computer to control this phone
mobileComputerControlHint: Enable for this paired computer while connected. Keep the phone unlocked; Stop in the task notification ends access. Local phone tasks and remote control run separately.
mobileSpeechHint: Choose the phone's recognition service and language. System recognition may use the network. Default language follows the app.
speechOnDeviceUnavailable: On-device recognition is unavailable. Choose System service or install a supported language in Android settings.
title: Phone access
subtitle: Pair your phone once to chat with the agent on this computer and capture Live input. Reachable LAN connections are preferred; public access keeps you connected away from home.
keepRunning: Keep Nexa running and the computer awake. Remote access stops when Nexa exits. Your existing agent permissions still apply.
lanEnableHint: Encrypted LAN access. Trust this installation’s certificate on your phone once to use the local route and microphone.
quickHint: Use reachable free HTTPS tunnels, with Cloudflare as an additional option.
fixedHint: For a stable address, configure your own HTTPS tunnel to http://127.0.0.1:8790, then enter its public origin here.
sshHint: With an existing SSH server and a phone SSH client, forward phone localhost:8790 to this computer’s 127.0.0.1:8790. Then open http://127.0.0.1:8790 on the phone.
qrHint: Enable access to create a pairing code.
pairHint: Scan the QR code on Nexa’s Phone access page, or enter the six-digit code shown on the computer.
identityChanged: The computer identity does not match the QR code.
pairAuthority: Pair only your own devices. A paired device can read conversations and file previews, start agent work, answer prompts, and approve individual actions. Native phone pairing also shares model connections and API keys.
reconnectHint: Finding a reachable connection. Your chat stays on the computer; Live capture pauses during the switch. Keep this page open.
revokedHint: This device is no longer authorized. Forget the saved connection and scan a new QR code on the computer.
lanTrust: For faster LAN access, install this certificate in your phone’s trusted certificates and allow local network access. On iOS, also enable full trust in Certificate Trust Settings. Without this setup the public HTTPS route remains available.
chatEmpty: Choose a conversation or send a message to begin. Your computer runs the agent and keeps its working context.
messageHint: Ask your agent to do something…
chatFeatureHint: Read conversations, send instructions, and respond when your agent needs you.
liveFeatureHint: Use your phone’s microphone and camera, then turn observations into a summary.
temporaryHint: Free public addresses can change. Pinggy sessions last up to 60 minutes; Nexa reconnects automatically. After a long offline period, you may need to scan a new code.
stopToChange: Stop remote access to change these options.
connectedHint: Your phone is ready. You can leave this page and keep working.
pairedHint: This device is saved. Open its Nexa page to reconnect.
preparingHint: Preparing a secure connection. The first run may need to download the connection helper.
modelsUnavailable: Model discovery is unavailable. Saved choices are retained; you can retry or enter a model ID.
themeAssetUnavailable: The theme background is temporarily unavailable. Its colors remain active.
voiceInterrupted: The microphone connection was interrupted. Your text is preserved; start dictation again to continue.
voiceNeedsSetup: Configure streaming speech recognition in desktop Settings before using voice input.
microphoneNeedsHttps: Microphone access requires trusted HTTPS. Use the public link or trust the LAN certificate.
microphonePermission: Allow microphone access in your browser, then retry.
publicReconnecting: Public routes are being checked and reconnected automatically. LAN access remains available.
autoNetworkHint: Nexa checks HTTPS reachability and WebSocket connectivity, keeps an alternate route, and switches when a route fails. No server or account is required for the free providers.
routeUnavailable: This route is unavailable; another route will be tried automatically.
attachmentLimit: Up to 8 files and 8 MiB in total.
voiceReconnecting: Reconnecting microphone… Your text is preserved.
mobileLocalBoundary: Tasks and files stay on this phone
mobileRemoteBoundary: Your computer runs the task and keeps its files
mobilePhoneTitle: A little help, wherever you are
mobilePhoneHint: Notes, files, and a helping hand in other apps. Start by connecting a model.
mobileExample: Create a note with three priorities for today
mobileCredentials: Saved securely on this phone. Paired computers can share these model connections.
mobileControlHint: Phone control is optional. Nexa reads visible controls, omits password fields, and asks before acting. Stop any task from its notification.
mobilePairHint: On your computer, open Phone access and enable Public connection. Scan its QR code or paste the complete HTTPS pairing link below.
mobileFilesHint: Files created by phone tasks. Tap a file to share or save it with another app.
mobileRemoveConnectionHint: Remove this connection and its key from this phone. Copies on paired computers stay available.
mobileSyncTrustedHint: Pairing shares model connections and API keys. Each device keeps its own active model.
mobileSyncUnsupported: Update Nexa on this computer and pair again to sync model connections.
mobileSyncConflicts: {count} simultaneous edits were kept as separate connections.
mobileSyncDeviceOnly: {count} device-specific connections stay on their original device.
mobileScanInvalid: Scan a Nexa HTTPS pairing QR code from Phone access on your computer.
mobileAccessDisconnected: Enabled in settings; service is disconnected.
mobileReconnectAccessHint: Open accessibility settings, turn Nexa off and on, then return and check again.
mobileEnableAccessHint: Open Accessibility → Installed apps (or Downloaded apps) → Nexa and enable the service.
mobileRestrictedSettingsHint: If Android shows “Restricted settings”: open App info below → ⋮ → Allow restricted settings, then return to Accessibility. This requires your action and cannot be enabled by Nexa.
mobileBackgroundHelp: Keep tasks available in the background
mobileBackgroundHint: Battery restrictions can interrupt tasks. Review Nexa's battery setting if access keeps dropping. Force-stop or revoking access stops control; return here to reconnect.
mobileSamsungBatteryHint: Samsung: Settings → Battery → Background usage limits. Remove Nexa from Sleeping / Deep sleeping apps and add it to Never sleeping apps if available.
mobileVendorBatteryHint: Your device may also have Auto-launch, Background activity or Battery saver settings under App info. Allow background activity for Nexa when needed; names vary by system version.
mobileBackgroundRestricted: Android currently restricts this app's background activity.
mobileFloatingAssistantHint: A draggable shortcut to Nexa over other apps. Tap to open chat; hold to show Stop. Requires phone control access.
speechPermission: Allow microphone access in Android app settings, or use the keyboard.
speechUnavailable: Install or enable a speech engine in Android settings.
speechNetwork: The speech service could not connect. Check the network or choose an offline engine.
speechTimeout: The speech engine stopped responding. Try again or check Android voice settings.
speechLanguage: Install voice data for this language in Android text-to-speech settings.
speechBusy: Speech is already active. Stop it or close other microphone apps and try again.
speechFailed: Speech could not complete. Check Android voice settings and try again.
